name: Perk Variants (prototype)
description: PROTOTYPE, test worlds only. Three features, each switched on in the mod's settings (all off by default): variant drops (Epic and Legendary random loot from chests, enemy remains and bosses can drop as variants with rerolled enhancements; fixed chests, world items and direct enemy drops stay vanilla), crafted equipment rarity by item level, and Legendary crafted lore items. Vanilla items are never changed. Every player on a server needs the mod. To remove it: switch it off, then run variants-reverter on your saves before starting the game, or variant items are deleted.
